#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits.h>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    int to;
    long flow;
    long capacity;
    Edge dual;
    long cost;
    Edge(int to, long capacity, bool forward) {
        this->to = to;
        this->capacity = capacity;
        this->forward = forward;
    }
};

struct Node {
    vector<Edge> edges;
    int index;
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node> nodes;

    void link(int n1, int n2, long capacity) {
        Edge e12 = Edge(n2, capacity, true);
        Edge e21 = Edge(n1, 0, false);
        e12.dual = e21;
        e21.dual = e12;
        nodes[n1].edges.push_back(e12);
        nodes[n2].edges.push_back(e21);
    }

    void link(int n1, int n2, long capacity, long cost) {
        Edge e12 = Edge(n2, capacity, true);
        Edge e21 = Edge(n1, 0, false);
        e12.dual = e21;
        e21.dual = e12;
        e12.cost = cost;
        e21.cost = -cost;
        nodes[n1].edges.push_back(e12);
        nodes[n2].edges.push_back(e21);
    }

    void addNode() {
        Node n;
        n.index = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
    }

    virtual long getMaxFlow(int src, int snk) = 0;
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    virtual long[] getMinCostMaxFlow(int src, int snk) = 0;
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    long minCost;

    EdmondsKarp() {
        this(0);
    }

    EdmondsKarp(int n) {
        super(n);
    }

    long[] getMinCostMaxFlow(int src, int snk) {
        long maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return new long[] { maxflow, minCost };
    }

    long getMaxFlow(int src, int snk) {
        int n = nodes.size();
        long flow = 0;
        long cost = 0;
        long[] potential = new long[n];
        while (true) {
            Edge* parent = new Edge[n];
            long* dist = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                dist[i] = LONG_MAX;
            }
            dist[src] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<long, int>> que;
            que.push(make_pair(0, src));
            while (!que.empty()) {
                pair<long, int> item = que.top();
                que.pop();
                if (item.first != dist[item.second])
                    continue;
                for (Edge e : nodes[item.second].edges) {
                    long temp = dist[item.second] + e.cost + potential[item.second] - potential[e.to];
                    if (e.capacity > e.flow && dist[e.to] > temp) {
                        dist[e.to] = temp;
                        parent[e.to] = &e;
                        que.push(make_pair(temp, e.to));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[snk] == NULL)
                break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                if (parent[i] != NULL)
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
            long augFlow = LONG_MAX;
            for (int i = snk; i != src; i = parent[i]->to) {
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            }
            for (int i = snk; i != src; i = parent[i]->to) {
                Edge e = *parent[i];
                e.flow += augFlow;
                cost += augFlow * e.cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

class FastScanner {
public:
    string next() {
        string str;
        cin >> str;
        return str;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return stol(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    int[] readIntArray(int n) {
        int* a = new int[n];
        for (int idx = 0; idx < n; idx++) {
            a[idx] = nextInt();
        }
        return a;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    int N = scanner.nextInt();
    int M = scanner.nextInt();
    int K = scanner.nextInt();
    int C = scanner.nextInt();
    int D = scanner.nextInt();
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    int* people = scanner.readIntArray(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        people[i]--;
    }
    solver.addNode();
    solver.addNode();
    int amt = 150;
    Node** timeNodes = new Node*[N];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        timeNodes[i] = new Node[amt];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; j++) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j - 1].index, timeNodes[i][j].index, LONG_MAX);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        solver.link(0, timeNodes[people[i]][1].index, 1);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i].index, 1, 1, C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        int b = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < amt - 1; j++) {
            long prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j].index, timeNodes[b][j + 1].index, 1, D * k * k - prev);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j].index, timeNodes[a][j + 1].index, 1, D * k * k - prev);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    long* ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(0, 1);
    cout << ret[1] << endl;
    return 0;
}
